claims.head: Top line on top line: Forsberg against Tuch
claims.call: The Predators’ L1 (Forsberg, O'Reilly and Stamkos) spends at least 62% of its 5-on-5 time against the Capitals’ first line.
claims.body: At home, the Predators keep sending Forsberg’s line (Forsberg, O'Reilly and Stamkos) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Andrew Brunette has been choosing strength on strength. Tonight the Capitals’ first line is Tuch, Strome and Kyrou.

notes.text: The forward lines keep changing. Even their four most-used trios over the last 9 games cover only 24% of their forwards’ 5-on-5 time, the fifth-lowest in the league (a typical team: 43%). The lines listed lean on their latest games, but expect new combinations tonight.
Pierre-Luc Dubois is day to day (illness) and has missed the last 5 games. He is a top-six forward.
Rasmus Sandin is out long term (acl surgery) and has missed the last 5 games. He is a top-four defenseman. Cole Hutson has taken his spot beside Martin Fehérváry.
Justin Holl was added to the roster on Oct 16 and has played beside Cole Hutson.
Jonny Brodzinski was added to the roster on Oct 20 and has played beside Anthony Beauvillier and Ryan Leonard.
Jakob Chychrun has started killing penalties: on the ice for 26% of the team’s shorthanded time in 9 games, up from 8% last season.
